newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: ATHLETICS-ROMANIA'S FIDATOV WINS FIFTH CONSECUTIVE RACE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-ROMANIA'S FIDATOV WINS FIFTH CONSECUTIVE RACE.

text.p: Romania's Elena Fidatov won her fifth race this season with an impressive sprint finish in the seventh round of the world cross country challenge.
The 36-year-old dominated the six km event, holding off her main rival Olympic 10,000 metres champion Fernanda Ribeiro of Portugal.
Ribatov, who led the race from start to finish, clocked 19 minutes and 31 seconds, two seconds faster than Ribeiro.
Kenyan Tom Nyariki easily won the men's race, with a 22 second advantage over his compatriot Barnard Barmasai.
